system.description:
• Effect: You may found a castle (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d10 followers (Level 0) and one 1st-level Knight come to your banner, and you choose who stays.
  • Your scutage pays them: 3 gp a month for a follower, 4 gp a month per Level for a Knight.
  • While you hold it, a follower who has served a year may be knighted, as under Conversion to Knighthood.

activities.name: Followers this season
activities.text: Followers (Level 0) and one 1st-level Knight who come to your castle this season; you choose who stays. Scutage pays 3 gp a month for a follower and 4 gp a month per Level for a Knight.
